controls.check: Sensitive data is not stored in plaintext application storage.
Sensitive data is excluded from logs, screenshots, backups, and IPC.
Keystore-backed keys and appropriate accessibility flags protect local secrets.
Maintained platform cryptographic APIs are used correctly.
Keys have appropriate origin, purpose, rotation, and invalidation.
Sensitive operations require fresh server-verified authentication.
Sessions expire, revoke remotely, and are not persisted insecurely.
Authorization is enforced by the backend for every object and action.
All sensitive traffic uses modern TLS with hostname validation.
Cleartext traffic and user-added CAs are disabled for production.
Certificate pinning failures fail closed where pinning is required.
Exported components, deep links, and IPC enforce caller authorization.
WebViews disable unnecessary JavaScript, file access, and mixed content.
Third-party keyboards, clipboard, and overlays do not expose secrets.
Release builds remove debug endpoints, test credentials, and verbose logs.
Dependencies are supported, scanned, and free of known critical vulnerabilities.
Untrusted input is validated before native, SQL, WebView, or IPC use.
Tamper detection signals are verified server-side and never trusted alone.
High-risk workflows retain server authorization on rooted or instrumented devices.
Data collection is minimized, disclosed, and covered by retention controls.
Permissions are justified, runtime-scoped, and denied gracefully.
